messages:
maya: Morning async — quick standup for Edge Routing launch prep.
maya: What I did: wrote rollout checklist, updated spec PR.
maya: Blockers: need API perf numbers for dev vs prod QPS; code review pending on retries.
maya: Today: coordinate with infra for canary, finalize fallback policy.
jorge: I can run a QPS sweep and post numbers by 12:30 PT. Any preferred dataset? @liam
liam: Use the prod-shadow dataset from last run (s3://redwood-testing/prod-shadow-2026-02-10). Also opened issue #789 for latency regression.
priya: I'll review spec PR 482 today — quick note: need clearer section on fallback ordering.
deploy-bot: canary-deploy started for commit abc123 on dedicated pool. progress: 20% :rocket:
maya: Thanks. @jorge when you run please include p50/p95/p99/p999 and tail lat.
jorge: Will do. Running with this script:
```bash
wrk -t12 -c300 -d120s https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -s load.lua
```
liam: Heads up — if p99 spikes it's often KV cache warmup; try setting cache warmup to 50 prefix tokens for the run.
priya: Spec PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/482 — added fallback policy draft.
maya: :thumbsup: Decision: if p99 > 800ms on canary we rollback and switch to smaller model variant. tagging @eng-sre for alerting.
sam (eng-sre): On it — I'll add a PagerDuty alert for p99 > 800ms during canary window and a dashboard tile.
maya: Action items: 1) Jorge run sweep (by 12:30), 2) Priya finish spec PR (EOD), 3) Sam setup alert (today). Mark when done here.
jorge: 12:18 PT — posted results: p50 120ms, p95 420ms, p99 760ms, p999 1.2s. attaching csv (uploaded to thread files).
maya: Looks within threshold but p999 is high. Sam can you check if that's outliers or steady?
sam (eng-sre): Investigating — looks like 3 outliers from a single host in the pool. evicting node now.
liam: Re-run after node eviction should clean the tail.
jorge: Re-run done 13:05 PT: p999 0.95s now. uploading summary to the thread.
maya: Great. Moving to finalize canary rollout at 14:00. Thanks everyone. :party_parrot:
